title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Litleo Mega Symphonia 066/063 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Litleo 066/063 Art Rare m1S Mega Symphonia Japanese Pokemon Holo card is a highly sought after collectible card from the Pokémon TCG series. Featuring the character Litleo in a fiery red color, this card is part of the Mega Symphonia set and illustrated by Teeziro. Manufactured by Nintendo in Japan, this card is made of card stock with a holo finish, making it a valuable addition to any collector's deck.
